lina (ml): pulled preliminary results for cypress-embed-v1 on the canonical holdout (n=50k) — int8 vs int6 quick compare. gist: int6 keeps most recall but costs drop ~2.3x vs fp16. attaching numbers below.

raj (research): nice, can you paste the recall@1/5/10 and a small note about short-query behavior?

lina (ml): sure — short summary: recall@1 drops ~1.6% for int6 vs fp16 on short queries (<=16 tokens), but recall@5/10 almost identical. full metrics: `fp16: R@1=0.742, R@5=0.891, R@10=0.933, sil=0.36, median_cos_shift=0.0021`; `int8: R@1=0.735, R@5=0.888, R@10=0.930, sil=0.35, median_cos_shift=0.0068`; `int6: R@1=0.728, R@5=0.885, R@10=0.928, sil=0.34, median_cos_shift=0.0095`. latency p50 (cpu sim): fp16=8.9ms, int8=6.5ms, int6=4.1ms.

oliver (infra): those latency numbers look promising. what's the batch size and hardware for the numbers?

lina (ml): bench: A100-80GB, dynamic batching with 32 concurrency, effective batch=64 for throughput runs; short-query subset ran single-request microbench (no batching) to measure p50.

tia (pm): the 1.6% R@1 drop for short queries — is that user-facing in our evaluator or mostly synthetic? any examples where it breaks?

lina (ml): mostly synthetic — we saw failures on very terse anchors (e.g., single-token product codes) where nearest neighbor flips from ground truth to a close synonym. added a quick example inlined: `Q: "SKU-7A"` expected -> doc123, int6 -> doc214 (synonym grouping).

raj (research): can we try per-channel vs per-tensor quant for int6? sometimes per-channel fixes short-token id flips.

lina (ml): plan: run per-channel quantization sweep + calibration on real-query distribution (not uniform). kicking off sweep now. command: ```./eval_onboard.sh --model cypress-embed-v1 --quant int6 --mode sweep --calib-file s3://redwood-evals/cypress/calib.json --holdout 50000```

embed-bot: started job j-20260321-88 (sweep, int6, per-channel) — logs -> https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/j-20260321-88

oliver (infra): when the sweep finishes, can we also collect cluster purity + UMAP snapshots? want to eyeball topology changes.

lina (ml): yep will export cluster purity, silhouette, and two UMAP seeds (seed=42, seed=7). will post artifacts.

tia (pm): timeline? if int6 passes quality gating we can nominate for canary next week. if not, fallback to int8 config for Dedicated.

lina (ml): sweep ETA ~3h. will post interim summary and any surprising regressions. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

raj (research): thanks — also add recall@1 stratified by query-length deciles, that helped surface regressions before.

lina (ml): good call, adding stratified recall and a short-query-only confusion matrix.

embed-bot: job j-20260321-88 completed — results: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/j-20260321-88/summary.json (uploaded)

lina (ml): quick highlights from sweep: per-channel int6 recovered ~0.8% R@1 vs naive int6 on short queries (so delta vs fp16 now ~0.8% not 1.6%). cluster purity change small (0.36 -> 0.355). attaching minimal diff. recommend: promote per-channel int6 to extended canary (10M queries/day) with an automated rollback if short-query R@1 drops >1.0%.

oliver (infra): sounds good. I'll prepare canary config with fallback to int8 and route rules.

tia (pm): great — please open a tiny runbook for the canary with KPIs and rollback thresholds.

lina (ml): will do, PR incoming (link to PR in ~30m).
